prose:
A Hacker News poster says colleagues found Codex data-sharing settings enabled after previously switching them off. The thread asks whether this is isolated and links earlier discussions and account controls.

This is a user report, not a confirmed provider incident or evidence that every account changed. Comments and suggested workarounds do not establish a root cause, contractual exception or the actual training use of those conversations.
highlights: User reports an unexpected setting change
Actual training use is not established
